scope: Production GB10 inference metadata checks; complete warmed NoGrad attention API on full 48-SM GB10, B1/H16/D128, BF16/FP16, dense/causal S128/S512/S1024/S4096. No model or backward speedup claim.

native_and_gpu_body_equivalence.cpp_change: Additions only; every preceding native function body preserved byte-for-byte

fa2.name: fa2
fa2.layout_adapter: BHSD views to BSHD and back

protocol.boundary: Complete eager wall time; resident graph CUDA events divided by real captured call count. Rotate order, preparation/allocation included, compile/capture/profile construction excluded.

precision: Unchanged shifted-score attention and single-rounded operand policy; per-head independent FP64 O norm limit 1% BF16 / 0.5% FP16. FA2 and SDPA retain their own arithmetic.

h4_long_causal_training.scope: Compatibility with unchanged preceding training implementation; independent FP64 forward gates remain in the forward-only matrix

qualifier_mapping.scope: Actual production qualifier extension.__file__ matched /proc/self/maps; native module and exact compiler/include configuration retained before timing.

measured_eager_mapping.scope: Actual eager benchmark process /proc maps and module SHA, read-only OS metadata collection; no GPU work or profiling.

host.exact_build_configuration: SHA recorded in qualifier mapping; actual build.ninja with compiler flags/includes retained outside Git
host.pilot_limitation: Original pilot host mapping capture failed via SSH255; pre-existing cache retained separately, and final production actual mappings and library bytes provide this report's evidence.

sanitizers.scope: Retained actual-public memcheck/racecheck/synccheck/initcheck ownership passes from PR72; all native runner bodies and GPU sources preserved, and all final parent/selected CUDA functions and graph counts match.
